subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the Skill Workshop lifecycle approval fix follow the broader bounded-approval and actionable-timeout design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, or should maintainers choose a narrower timeout-only contract?
rationale: The fix changes how generated skill apply approvals expire and how long mutation approvals remain actionable, and there are multiple open PR shapes with different security and UX tradeoffs.

options.title: Use the broader bounded approval fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path, address its review blockers, and close this issue only after it lands.

options.title: Land a narrower watchdog-only repair
options.body: Choose a smaller fix that aligns the Codex dynamic-tool watchdog with the current approval ceiling while leaving richer approval UX and timeout messaging to separate work.

options.title: Pause for approval API direction
options.body: Hold all timeout PRs until approval owners decide the permanent timeout, metadata, and revision-binding contract.

recommendation.title: Use the broader bounded approval fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path, address its review blockers, and close this issue only after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and owns the current broader closing PR that already encodes the maintainer-facing design direction.
